overall_notes: The supplied two-way prices match the proposed half-point lines, but stale cross-book quotes and short game logs leave meaningful uncertainty around the estimated edges. All keeps are conditional on confirming the exact standard app line and current role; earlier winning legs provide no validation for these selections. Confidence reflects estimated hit probability for keeps and miss probability for cuts, so a cut can have confidence below 50 when its hit probability still falls short of break-even.

votes.reasoning: The exact-line market estimate and nine straight games below two made threes support an under based on baseline shooting volume, without requiring reduced minutes. The small sample and occasional five-attempt game leave shooting variance as the main risk. A recent increase in attempts or a materially weaker current price would change my vote.

The exact-line devig clears all supplied break-even thresholds, and eight hits in ten games with substantial minutes provide supporting evidence. Missing attempt totals and the difficult defensive matchup make the margin less secure than the raw hit rate suggests. Falling shooting volume or a current market estimate below approximately 55% would change my vote.
